title: an addon's page in the panel, contract version 1
description: The props of an addon's page (PRD 13.4), Addon in js/panel, which the panel serves below /x/<namespace>/: the page's id, which names the contribution whose component the host renders with its data from the deferred prop ext.<namespace>, the addon's namespace and the address the logout posts to. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\AddonPage, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

addon.description: The namespace of the addon whose page it is.

logout.description: The address the logout posts to.

page.description: The page's id, the id of its PageContribution, `<namespace>.<local>`, under which the addon's bundle registers the page's component and under which its data comes in ext.<namespace>.
